scope: Fresh Verilated 0.3 board core at 50.4 MHz with 25.2 MHz virtual host and pixel clocks. Clocks measured through the fence with identical packets, upload bytes and asset residency. Independent SRR compares both full RGB565 framebuffers and all D24 words. Physical board performance is unmeasured.

continuous.release_gate: No cumulative fence delay. Retain individual increases and interpret using matched starts.

mixed_depth_seed_reproduction.scope: The original seed pass benefits from burst reads. The matched comparison uses equivalent SRR-checked depth and color with at most two references per tile in each seed pass. Original two-phase seed-plus-draw timings remain recorded.

matched_dirty_skip_seed_scope: Both revisions upload the attachment independently produced by SRR for original A, copy it with COPY_RECT, and reproduce A's depth-discard validity, leaving D24 at the boot value. Both full color attachments and D24 are checked against original A before B. The natural timings remain above.

rejected_variant.analysis: Both passes had sixteen exactly-two-reference tiles. The shorter reference time shifted the phase of later SDRAM activity and cache stalls. The selected shared sequencer reads one word per request for lists shorter than three references.
